observation_source: Enumerate all 104 preserved build/catalog-host/captures/*/{upstream,patched}-{0,1}/result.json files directly. Derive case/role/repeat from original paths and read independently observed frame_sha256 lists before comparison with any published metadata; then compare every sequence with run-manifests.json and capture role lists.
canonical_payload: case name -> engine role -> decimal repeat index string -> ordered complete RGB-frame SHA256 list; UTF8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False and allow_nan=False
scope: Every frame in all 26 cases and both repeats of both roles, including unpublished frames/cases. Excludes mutable request/source annotations, timings and manifests. No rendering or artifact rewrite.
